item.title: What’s Left of Iran’s Air Force After Operation Epic Fury
item.description: Before Operation Epic Fury began on February 28, 2026, Iran’s air force was already in trouble. Decades of sanctions had left its fighter fleet aging, parts-starved, and increasingly difficult to sustain.
